arguments.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.XCL_001
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp AS d ON a.XCL_001 = d.XCL_015
JOIN client AS c ON d.XCL_014 = c.XCL_009
WHERE d.XCL_016 = 'OWNER'
  AND c.XCL_010 = 'M'
  AND c.XCL_011 BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
      AND t.XCL_053 = 'SIPO'
      AND t.XCL_051 > 4000
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans AS t2
    WHERE t2.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
      AND t2.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  )
ORDER BY a.XCL_001

  AND c.XCL_010 = 'M'
  AND c.XCL_011 BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
      AND t.XCL_053 = 'SIPO'
      AND t.XCL_051 > 4000
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans AS t2
    WHERE t2.XCL_047 = a.XCL_001
      AND t2.XCL_050 = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  )
ORDER BY a.XCL_001
